integrity: The proof is symbolic: cumulative paperfolding balance is identified with binary run count, and all admissible return intervals are classified. A standalone verifier independently cross-checks the paperfolding construction, the balance identity, finite endpoint intervals, and canonical witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes the regular paperfolding convention and classifies only which Dyck-factor lengths occur. It does not count such factors, classify nesting levels, or cover arbitrary paperfolding sequences.
title: Dyck-factor lengths in the regular paperfolding word
